KIMI LINEAR: AN EXPRESSIVE, EFFICIENT ATTENTION ARCHITECTURE
Figure 3 from the Kimi Linear paper: Illustration of the Kimi Linear model architecture.
By inspecting the model weights of the linear attention layer of the Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, we can identify three
parameters corresponding to the gated delta rule. Specifically, "f_a_proj.weight" and "f_b_proj.weight" constitute the low-
rank parameterization for the gate rule(\alpha), while "b_proj.weight" corresponds to the delta rule(\beta).
